item.title: 🎧 LISTEN #1 — Future Commerce: DoorDash’s Ads Chief on Planning for Moments Over Audiences
item.content:encoded:
Score: 83/100 | Listen Fully | Confidence: low

Originally published 28 Oct 2026

High strategic density on commerce media measurement, causal incrementality certification, and operational real-time inventory feed architectures.

Summary

Katie Daleo, GM of CPG Ads at DoorDash, explains the platform's shift from audience-based targeting to context and moment-based targeting in local commerce. She discusses obtaining third-party Alliance for Audited Media incrementality certification, optimizing commerce media against actual order conversions rather than impressions, and how DoorDash's Brand Center converts driver on-shelf sightings into real-time inventory and substitution data.

Key Ideas

  • DoorDash uses driver shelf-scan inputs to continuously update real-time local availability and item substitution models, bridging the online-to-shelf data gap.
  • Commerce media decisioning is pivoting from demographic audience segments to intent-driven 'moments' evaluated purely on certified incrementality and conversion orders.

Implications

['eCommerce ad networks must build verified incrementality directly into the measurement stack to maintain pricing power as ad buyers abandon impression-based metrics.', 'Integrating real-time physical shelf data into consumer decision engine logic reduces order friction and substitution failures.']
